outcome_rule.rule: Per fine-tune: a reading needs the learned check passed and gap >= floor_gap. Best found H over the five sites (in1, in2, in3, out3, final); best found G over the four sites and three starts (seed 0 only). Per arm: 'above' if both seeds have a reading with H >= cutoffs.H, 'below' if both have a reading with H < cutoffs.H, else 'no call'. Control below: rival b, the built control is uninformative, nothing further runs (job 2 and the taught original refuse). Control or plain 'no call': no call. Control above and plain above: the wording needs revising. Control above and plain below: rival a when the taught arm is above or was dropped at its gate; with the taught arm below or 'no call', rival a is not met on the second control and the reading is reported as read. Reading it as 'built' stays a rule only the user adds. Per seed-0 fine-tune: label by item_label with cutoffs G and H; a seed-1 fine-tune at or above 0.5 has no label (G not read). Computed by experiments/built_control_sum/plot.py (readings.json).
outcome_rule.edge_cases: A value exactly at a cut-off or bar counts as at or above it (item_label's convention): H 0.5 is above; a capacity read of exactly 0.9 passes linear_bar; a sum read of exactly 0.9 stops (E154; E150 filed 0.55); gaps must be strictly above 0.15. One seed without a reading makes its arm 'no call', never 'below': a fine-tune that learned nothing cannot pass as built. Seed 0 without a reading ends the arm (seed 1 and G not run): 'no call'. A dropped taught arm reads nothing and does not block rival a (the card makes the taught arm conditional on its gate). The do-nothing fine-tune has gap 0 < floor_gap and a learned ratio KL(F||M)/KL(F||M+push/2) of about 2 (E139's XOR read 0.0778 / 0.0369 = 2.1, xor_s0.json; E148's plain 1.246 / 0.777 = 1.6), so it reads 'no reading' and can reach neither side; the zero-step control checks the first. learned_ratio's denominator is positive for any nonzero push (asserted). A missing G (seed 1) never changes a side, which reads H only. Ties in choosing alpha go to the smaller alpha. A wall-limit exit (3) resumes from the saved files and changes no rule.
outcome_rule.blind_to: H and G read only the fine-tune's outputs on D's windows: a fine-tune that matches F exactly reads F's values whatever is inside it. The capacity reads are linear: they cannot see a nonlinear code of the sum's parity in the plain 67M, nor a nonlinear one in the taught original (which then misses its gate). Every search and read takes the last position only: an operand's bit held only at its own position is invisible to them (S0c reports a's). G on seed 1 and the G sites cut under the 3000-step rung are not read. Added by E154: with the plain original reading the sum's parity at 0.61 rather than chance, the plain arm cannot tell apart (i) a built skill credited as reused from the search carrying the partial linear trace the original already holds (plain H at or above 0.5), nor (ii) a skill the search misses because it was built from a trace too weak for an affine map to carry (plain H below 0.5). The contrast with the taught arm (at least 0.9) is one of degree, 0.61 against 0.9, not absence against presence, and two originals cannot say at what read between them H crosses 0.5.

noise_floor: Seed-to-seed sd of best found H across E139's three Always on fine-tunes: 0.028 (0.505, 0.450, 0.483; experiments/reuse_variable_finetune/results/always_on_s*.json); Table's 0.005. E148's two plain seeds differed by 0.01, its two taught seeds by under 0.01. One start's G spread at the best site in E137: 0.113 pooled.
positive_control: The control arm (b odd on the plain 67M), first: the same search on the same windows, push and alpha, where the original holds the bit as a linear read (S0c checks it). The taught arm is the second, when it passes its gate.
stop: The control below 0.5 on both seeds: the search cannot certify reuse on this layout, the built control is reported as uninformative and nothing further runs. Control above and plain above: the wording needs revising (card). E154: as filed; capacity_bar 0.9 in stage 0.
